title: S51b: Saturated pile-up energy recovery from censored pulse windows
claimed_ticket_text: S51b: Saturated pile-up energy recovery from censored pulse windows

evaluation_design.split: train and held-out sets are disjoint by source run
evaluation_design.negative_control: clipped clean single-pulse controls with matched source-run distribution

winner.name: saturation_residual_fusion_new
winner.criterion: minimum registered S51b held-out censored saturation-energy, timing, pile-up, pedestal, and PID-proxy composite score with run-block bootstrap CIs

caveats: Truth comes from controlled injections into raw-ROOT-derived clean pulses.
ADC clipping is a benchmark stressor, not decoded electronics metadata.
PID-dependent failure is represented by stave and charge-support proxies.
Bootstrap CIs resample held-out runs and quantify run-transfer uncertainty.
